title: Emit resumable_job metrics from KubernetesPodOperator
decision: Reuse existing resumable_job.* counters tagged operator="KubernetesPodOperator" with no new metric names
why: Easier tracking when operator tag lets a reader count saves without caring which mechanism produced them, which is the question being asked
quote: Reusing `resumable_job.*` over inventing a KPO specific name.
